profile.headline: Software Engineer · .NET / Blazor / AWS · Leading cross-team initiatives at United Airlines
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, APIs, and cloud-native solutions primarily in the .NET ecosystem.  

I care deeply about clean architecture, maintainable code, and building things the right way — not just the fast way. I enjoy working across the stack, mentoring other developers, and leading technical initiatives that have real impact across teams.  

More recently I've integrated AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) into my day-to-day workflow, including driving full feature implementations end-to-end using AI and CLI tooling. It's changed how I work and I think it's becoming a core engineering skill.  

Currently at United Airlines doing full-stack software development, building backend services and APIs on top of AWS infrastructure, with a focus on platform reliability and development velocity across teams

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Serve as technical lead on the Personalization team, owning architecture and delivery of backend services and
APIs supporting high-traffic enterprise systems
• Architected and delivered personalized content solutions powered by AWS Personalize, establishing the
platform's recommendation engine for in-flight entertainment
• Designed and owns data pipeline infrastructure streaming and processing large volumes of operational and
customer data via AWS Kinesis and Athena
• Introduced and standardized reusable internal .NET libraries adopted across 4+ teams, eliminating duplicated
code across 3 repositories and setting team-wide development patterns
• Drove and executed migration of 12 CI/CD pipelines from TeamCity to Harness, reducing build failures by ~20%
and improving deployment reliability
• Defined and enforced GitHub branch rules and automation standards, establishing quality gates adopted across
multiple teams
• Established cross-team collaboration model across 3 onshore and 2 offshore teams, improving delivery visibility
and reducing coordination overhead
• Authored comprehensive technical documentation that reduced engineer onboarding time by ~30%, becoming
the standard onboarding resource for the team
• Championed adoption of AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) across the team, driving
end-to-end feature implementations via AI and CLI workflows
• Led POC evaluations of enterprise AI agent platforms (Sierra.ai, Decagon.ai), presenting findings and
architectural recommendations to stakeholders
• Integrated headless CMS architecture using Contentstack to enable dynamic personalized content delivery at
scale
• Mentor engineers on Clean Architecture, system design principles, and AI-assisted development workflows; lead
code reviews and drive technical standards

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Extended and maintained core REST APIs consumed by mobile, web, and partner platforms
• Designed technical solutions and authored system designs in Confluence for sprint planning and stakeholder
alignment
• Integrated third-party compliance and AML services to reduce fraud and regulatory risk
• Led multi-developer initiatives, coordinating delivery and technical direction across onshore and offshore
contributors
• Spearheaded migration from .NET Framework to .NET Core across 5 services (4 microservices + 1 core
monolithic service) with a cross-functional team of 6
• Implemented automated testing with xUnit and Moq to increase coverage and reduce regression risk
• Improved SDLC processes, Git branching strategies, and Jira tracking standards to streamline sprint delivery
• Contributed to architecture reviews and participated in cross-team technical planning sessions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Elk Grove Village, Illinois, United States
positions.description:
• Built and maintained customer portal features using ASP.NET Core MVC, improving usability and self-service
capabilities
• Developed and documented backend APIs and microservices powering presentation layer applications
• Integrated third-party risk screening and compliance services into core workflows
• Designed domain models and relational database schemas to support new product features and reporting
requirements
• Diagnosed and resolved production incidents, implementing root-cause fixes to prevent recurrence
• Collaborated closely with business analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
• Participated in code reviews and contributed to establishing team coding standards

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented features to support migration of on-prem file management system to AWS S3, improving scalability
and reducing storage costs
• Designed and built internal admin tools and analytics APIs used by operations and support teams
• Migrated data access layer from ADO.NET to Entity Framework, reducing boilerplate and improving
maintainability
• Modernized legacy ASP.NET applications to ASP.NET Core, improving performance and long-term supportability
• Implemented Azure Functions for automated invoice processing, reducing manual effort for the finance team
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver features on schedule
• Wrote unit and integration tests to improve code reliability and reduce regression defects

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Develop dynamic, modern and visually appealing websites from scratch using Twitter Bootstrap, Javascript, and CSS.
• Collaborate with UI/UX tram to create wireframes and interfaces for best user experience.
• Interacting with clients to understand/discover business needs and gather requirements for projects.
• Connecting client websites to Firebase database for projects that require data to be stored. 
• Redesign/upgrading pre-existing client websites to modern standards and implementing new features depending on the client’s business need. Features including third party chat bots,  a means for users to contact the business right from the website.

• Implement SEO best practices to elevate the client’s web presence.
